description: This file defines a custom watch face service for Wear OS devices that displays the current time along with user's daily step count from Google Fit API. It manages GoogleApiClient connections, fetches step data, and renders time and step count on the watch face, handling ambient and interactive modes.

classes.name: FitStepsWatchFaceService
classes.description: A WatchFaceService that displays time and step count from Google Fit.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Main engine class implementing watch face rendering, lifecycle, and Google Fit data handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes paints, GoogleApiClient, registers receivers, and sets style.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the current time and step data onto the canvas depending on ambient mode.

methods.name: getTotalSteps
methods.description: Requests total daily step count from Google Fit API.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the daily total step count request and updates the step total.

methods.name: subscribeToSteps
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time step count updates via Google Fit Recording API.

methods.name: updateTimer
methods.description: Schedules or cancels the periodic time updates based on visibility and mode.
